svg.title: The mx folder contract
svg.desc: An mx project root contains a thin Makefile dispatcher, a make directory with one include per verb, a scripts directory holding the actual bash, an apps directory with one directory per service that mx never edits, and a docker directory split into dot-config for env files, compose for the baseline and dev override, system for infrastructure you own, and dockerfiles for per-service build files.
